asks: Do you want to know what happened in here?
Why do you keep standing under me?
description: The light is an eye. It's open, and it's the only source of illumination in the room, so everything you can see here you're seeing by it.
emotes: {it} blinks, and the room goes briefly and completely black.
{it} tracks slowly across to the door and back.
{it} narrows, and the light narrows with it.
looks: The iris is pale and enormous and the light comes out of the pupil, steadily.
It dries out after a while and closes, and the room goes dark for exactly as long as the blink lasts.
It's aimed at the middle of the room, which is where you keep having to stand.
name: an eye set into the ceiling
says: I have seen everything that happened in here.
You can turn me off. I'll still be here.
Don't stand in the corner. I have to strain.
